summary: A full rebuild of the resource projection, as a replay or a checkpoint proof runs, keeps the row of an item that only vcs.item.state claims describe, so members that took the same claims in a different order hold the same resource_observations.

replay.detail: The full replay stage and the projection hook that rebuild resource_observations now queue every subject with a resource.observed or vcs.item.state claim, not only the former. No claim is rewritten.

schema.detail: No table, column, trigger or storage version changes. The projection version is unchanged: a rebuild under this build produces what refreshes already produced for such subjects.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule or rules digest changes. resource_observations is a shared projection whose digest a checkpoint proof compares: a proof rebuilds it, so before this fix a proof disagreed with refreshed members on any item that only vcs.item.state claims describe. That is safe to change now because no deployed build writes vcs.item.state, so no member holds such an item; old and new builds rebuild identical rows for every other subject.

compatibility.detail: Members of the previous plugin-store build hold the same rows unless they ran a full replay or a checkpoint proof after taking a compact-only item; no build writes vcs.item.state yet, so no deployed member holds such an item.

recovery.detail: Rolling back to the previous build is supported; it rebuilds as before, which matters only once a poller writes vcs.item.state.
